highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.4 corrects Ganesh cache cleanup after failed GPU flushes.

bullets.lead: Avoid reusing uninitialized textures after a failed flush
bullets.detail: Ganesh now evicts uniquely held thread-safe-cache entries when render-task execution, instantiation, or preFlush fails, preventing later cache hits on those entries. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed.

v4.152.4.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.4 corrects Ganesh cache cleanup after failed GPU flushes.
v4.152.4.body: The fix evicts uniquely held thread-safe-cache entries to prevent later reuse of uninitialized textures; entries still held elsewhere are not removed. Managed APIs and the bundled HarfBuzz dependency are unchanged.
